label: NEW CERTIFICATION
label_note: Two-generation ARM certification baseline: NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 Grace Blackwell) certified 2026-09-26, TDA4VM (2x Cortex-A72) certified 2026-10-03. The TDA4VM lane is labeled NEW CERTIFICATION for the current code even though the April 2026 TDA4VM regression baseline was later recovered (regression report 20260411_112740: qwen2/qwen3/qwen35/gemma PASS at --context-len 100, nanbeige OOM on 2 GB; evidence tarball sha256 94e02ada4fcdad45212455de3e633edb566b43be1f8f04463bd7c85a3ee1db70) — the April evidence predates the current runtime and does not cover it. All three machines (x86, Spark Grace, TDA4VM A72) ran bit-identical weights.

cke_revision.base_note: Spark measurements taken at base 50cb9915b6f449b25bc89a08170b83f6eddb52c9 + this branch's original build fixes; those fixes (immintrin guard, Q4_K symbol stubs) were superseded by PR #584 on main (guarded call sites + mixed-bump rewrite + ARM CI lane). TDA4VM measurements taken on main b5f03325c plus this branch's DeltaNet scalar fallback fix.

arm_fixes_landed_via.pr_584_main: guarded x86-only Q4_K packed-provider call sites (axpy/hyper_connection), file-backed mixed BUMP weights (fixes the April 'weights_base == 0 (got 448)' mixed-fallback rejection), _GNU_SOURCE/_POSIX_C_SOURCE portability, ubuntu-24.04-arm CI lane
arm_fixes_landed_via.this_branch: gated_deltanet_llama_avx2_grouped_forward_transposed_impl scalar fallback (qwen35 ARM gibberish fix); --logits-layout auto plans last-position logits (full-sequence planning-bug fix)

first_prefill_logits.oracle_note: PyTorch oracle: transformers + torch fp32, GGUF dequantized, same 10 prompt IDs, last-position logits. ARM builds are slightly CLOSER to the fp32 oracle than x86; both share CKE's common reduced-intermediate-precision offset. Top-3 order identical across all; top-8 sets identical.

qwen35_0.8b_q4_k_m.root_cause: gated_deltanet_llama_avx2_grouped_forward_transposed_impl has an AVX2-only body and a no-op #else; on ARM the recurrent core silently did nothing (state never updates). qwen35_0.8b_q4_k_m.status_after_fix: PASS: 32-token greedy trajectory matches x86 exactly; first logits cosine 0.99768, max-abs 0.97, argmax 248068 both

nanbeige4.1_3b_q4_k_m.main_b5f03325c: loads and generates at ctx 1024 but output is incoherent ('Weimplify is asked: ...'); not certified — suspected numerics issue in the hybrid/Q4_K path on ARM, unbisected

full_sequence_logits_planning_bug.symptom: with --logits-layout auto (the default), v8 prefill memory planning reserved context_len x vocab x fp32 logits scratch: 37,817,942,016 bytes (35.2 GiB) for gemma3 270M at its 32768-token default context, 24 GiB class reservations for qwen2 — ck_huge_alloc aligned_alloc fails on the 2 GB TDA4VM (gemma-main-ctxdefault.log) and inflates arenas everywhere
full_sequence_logits_planning_bug.root_cause: build_ir_v8.py _resolve_logits_layout mapped auto -> 'full' for prefill (vestige of vision encoder bring-up, 864ca2666), although chat/serving/probes only consume last-position logits; no circuit declares 'full'; training already passes explicit --logits-layout full
full_sequence_logits_planning_bug.fix: auto now resolves to 'last' for prefill and decode (this branch); explicit 'full' unchanged. Gemma ctx-1024 arena shrinks 1,445,192,256 -> 372,499,008 bytes; x86 numerics bit-identical (probe logits max-abs 0.0, trajectory unchanged); regression test tests/test_v8_logits_layout_auto.py (7 tests)
full_sequence_logits_planning_bug.mitigation_confirmed: --logits-layout last makes even the default-32768-context runtime load and run on the TDA4VM (gemma-main-last.log)

optimized_provider_pass_spark.conclusion: No numerical drift and no meaningful performance change. The repo contains NEON (arm_neon.h) providers only for q5_0/q8_0/q6k_q8k GEMM kernels and NO SVE/SVE2 providers anywhere (no arm_sve.h in the tree); the dominant gemma3 270M GEMMs execute as portable scalar C on ARM. No optimization is claimed.

regression_fixture.test: tests/test_arm_spark_baseline.py (pytest; skips unless platform.machine() is aarch64/arm64 and a compiled runtime exists at CK_ARM_SPARK_MODEL_DIR or the default cache path)

known_limitations: Q4_K packed-provider routes (prefill packed-meta and VNNI dispatch) remain x86-only in provider coverage; on ARM the generic Q4_K/Q8_K paths run instead (correct after PR #584; performance untuned).
nanbeige4.1-3B is incoherent on the TDA4VM on main (unbisected ARM numerics issue; April baseline OOM'd it on 2 GB).
The canonical cks-v8-run flow compiles model_v8.c with -march=native on all hosts; the generic-ISA baseline applies to the engine/tokenizer libraries.
Post-EOS 106/107 near-ties are below run-to-run numeric noise and are not pinned.
TDA4VM timings are heavily swap/storage constrained (2 GB RAM + 4 GB swapfile); treat them as functional evidence, not performance guidance.
